As Donald Trump's failed war in Iran allegedly nears its conclusion, as a
humiliating and well-deserved defeat, our authoritarian president is pivoting
back to his other [unsuccessful war](https://zeteo.com/p/minnesota-trump-
siege-americans) - his assault on Americans.

Trump [never truly ended](https://zeteo.com/p/donald-trump-ice-occupation-
minnesota) his siege of Minnesota, and he never stopped deploying violent,
masked federal agents to kidnap immigrants and abuse U.S. citizens. But ever
since he launched his illegal war on Iran in February, his administration has
been largely consumed with waging that regional bloodbath, to the slight
expense of his ability to wage war on his fellow citizens.
